component.name: GNU DDD (Data Display Debugger)
component.summary: Graphical front end for the command-line debuggers GDB and CUDA-GDB

description.p: GNU DDD (Data Display Debugger) is a graphical front end for the command-line debuggers GDB and CUDA-GDB.

DDD provides interactive graphical data display (visualizing data structures as graphs), it enables source-level debugging with breakpoints, watchpoints, and call stacks, and it has support for multiple debuggers, with active development focused on GDB and CUDA-GDB.

ul.li: Font handling has been redesigned to use XFT client-side fonts. The font preference menu now has a drop-down menu to select compatible fonts.
Add side-by-side view for source and data.
Add dark mode.
Line number width adapts to the size of source file.
Display of UTF-8 in source window and debugger console.
Convert ddd.1 (ddd.man) to UTF-8.
Change default editors gvim or emacs, instead of kdevelop and vi in xterm.
Remove Make and Edit buttons from Tool Bar.
Fix dialogs for register, breakpoints, displays.
Several issues which prevented building on macOS have been resolved.
DDD is now built with internal X11 default attributes, vsl definitions. Several --enable-builtin-x options removed.
Additional derived files are built in the build directory instead of the source directory.
Support parallel make (-j >n<).
Eliminate unneeded functions and headers.
Cleanup and reorganization in multiple areas: M4 use in Makefile, GDBAgent.
Correct prereq script for Ubuntu/Debian.
Obsolete files have been removed: PROBLEMS, ddd.spec, GDB manual, FONTS
Update splash screen to ddd-3.4
DDD Reference manual is available under Help menu.
Documents are now in doc directory in distribution tarball and are installed in /usr/share/ddd-<version>/doc.
